eyebrow: Course · Brazilian Portuguese for English speakers
heading: Learn Brazilian Portuguese from first words to C1.
lead: A complete course in the Portuguese of Brazil, written for English speakers: 76 modules in eight tiers, with the grammar explained directly, over 5,000 exercises with feedback that gives the reason, and every Portuguese word open to tap for its meaning, forms and audio.
fineprint: The whole course is free, with the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test. Specializations, conversation practice, stories, the Celpe-Bras papers and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

panel.label: The course in eight tiers

items.title: Tier 1 · Sounds and first words
items.text: Pronunciation and spelling, greetings, articles, ser, numbers.

items.title: Tier 2 · Everyday basics
items.text: -ar, -er and -ir verbs, ter and gostar, questions, family, time.

items.title: Tier 3 · Daily life
items.text: Irregular verbs, ser, estar and ficar, contractions, food, the city.

items.title: Tier 4 · The past
items.text: The preterite and the imperfect, object pronouns, travel, health.

items.title: Tier 5 · Building fluency
items.text: Pronoun placement, the future, the conditional, the imperative, work.

items.title: Tier 6 · Intermediate
items.text: The present subjunctive, the pluperfect, reported speech.

items.title: Tier 7 · Upper intermediate
items.text: The future subjunctive, the personal infinitive, the passive, society.

items.title: Tier 8 · Advanced
items.text: Compound subjunctive tenses, style, spoken and regional Portuguese.

panel.note: 5 to 12 modules per tier. The placement test lets you start further up.

sections.heading: What the course teaches, and how

items.title: One variety, consistently
items.text: The course teaches the Portuguese of Brazil: você, Brazilian spelling, vocabulary and pronunciation throughout. European Portuguese and regional variation have a module of their own in Tier 8.

items.title: Grammar explained directly
items.text: Each grammar module states the rule, with examples, before you practise it: ser, estar and ficar, where the object pronoun goes, the future subjunctive and the personal infinitive, which English does not have.

items.title: Feedback that says why
items.text: Every answer is graded with a reason and a link to the rule in the grammar reference, so a wrong ending tells you which form was needed and why.

items.title: Reading, listening, writing and speaking
items.text: Exercises include translation, cloze, dictation, listening, form tables and readings, and speaking exercises with pronunciation feedback.

items.title: Every word inspectable
items.text: Tap any Portuguese word in an exercise, reading or explanation for its meaning, its forms and its audio.

items.title: Brazil in the topics
items.text: Topic modules cover food, the city, work, the media, politics and society, history, literature, law and humour, with spoken Brazilian Portuguese taught in a module of its own.

sections.heading: Practice papers for Celpe-Bras
sections.intro: The course has timed practice papers for one exam:
items: Celpe-Bras, Brazil's certificate of proficiency in Portuguese: four practice papers for its written part, with original content. The oral part is not included.

sections.heading: Portuguese for your field
sections.intro: Thirteen specialization courses teach the vocabulary of a profession in nine modules each, in three stages: Foundations from Tier 4, Working vocabulary from Tier 6 and Professional from Tier 8.

items.question: Is this Brazilian or European Portuguese?
items.answer: Brazilian. The vocabulary, spelling and audio follow Brazilian norms throughout. One Tier 8 module covers how European Portuguese and the regions of Brazil differ.

items.question: Is the course really free?
items.answer: Yes. All 76 modules from A1 to C1, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free. Premium adds specializations, conversation practice, stories, the Celpe-Bras papers and the other extras.

items.question: I already know some Portuguese. Do I have to start at the beginning?
items.answer: No. The placement test finds the tier that fits and starts you there.

items.question: Can I practise speaking?
items.answer: Yes. The course has speaking exercises with pronunciation feedback. Premium adds conversation practice with an AI character and pronunciation practice on any sentence you type.

items.question: I speak Spanish. Is there a course for me?
items.answer: Yes. Brazilian Portuguese for Spanish speakers is a shorter course of 40 modules, explained in Spanish and built around what differs from Spanish.

closing.heading: Start with the first module, or the placement test.
closing.text: Sign in with Google, take the placement test if you already know some Portuguese, and open your first module.
